text:
The plan below misses no episodes. It costs 2×$10.99 + 2×$15.49 + 3×$11.99 = **$88.93**, and each service has the fewest periods possible.

**Starting state**
- On 11-01 to 11-12, Lumen, Kestrel+, Northline and Orbit are all already paid. That is 4 services, which is over the limit of 3. So no new period may give access on those days.
- No title is on Kestrel+, so it is left to switch off on 11-13.
- From 11-13 on, at most 3 services (Lumen, Northline, Orbit) are ever active, so the concurrency limit is never broken.

**Orbit – The Hollow Lantern (10 weekly episodes, 7-day windows)**
- Episodes 1–2 are covered by the already-paid access, which runs through 11-12.
- A period starting 11-17 gives access 11-17 to 12-16. That covers episodes 3–7; episode 7's window starts 12-15.
- A period starting 12-29 gives access 12-29 to 01-28. That covers episode 8 (its window ends 12-29) and episodes 9–10.
- One period cannot cover episodes 3–10, so 2 periods is the minimum.

**Lumen – The Quiet Orchard and Quiet Harbor**
- The Quiet Orchard's window is 11-26 to 12-03. A period starting 11-26 covers it and does not overlap the paid access, which ends 11-22.
- Quiet Harbor's window is 02-23 to 03-29. A period starting 02-23 covers it.
- The two windows are about three months apart, so 2 periods are needed.

**Northline – The Northern Harbor (12 weekly episodes) and Copper Atlas**
- A period starting 12-20 gives access 12-20 to 01-19. That covers episodes 1–6; episode 1's window ends 12-20.
- A period starting 01-24 gives access 01-24 to 02-23. That covers episodes 7–11; episode 11's window ends 02-28.
- A period starting 02-28 covers episode 12 and the Copper Atlas film, whose window is 02-22 to 04-02.
- Episode 1 must be watched by 12-20 and episode 12 not before 02-28. Two months from 12-20 only reaches 02-19, so 3 periods are needed.

None of the periods for the same service overlap.
